rationale: Correct the existing Convergent record without creating a second ECP owner. Convergent Energy and Power and Convergent Energy + Power are one platform. ECP acquired it through Fund IV in 2019 and continues to list it as current; the exact acquisition vehicle, legal closing day, seller and stake remain not publicly disclosed. DOE, MUFG and NY Green Bank facilities are project or portfolio financing rather than platform ownership.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Convergent Energy and Power
companyFieldUpdates.description: Convergent Energy and Power Inc. develops, finances, owns, operates and optimizes battery-storage and solar-plus-storage infrastructure for commercial, industrial, utility, municipal, cooperative and developer customers across the United States and Canada, including Puerto Rico. ECP acquired the platform through Fund IV in 2019 and continues to classify it as current. The acquisition was signed in April and announced July 10, 2019; public sources do not disclose the exact legal closing day, acquisition vehicle, seller or stake. Convergent reported approximately 800 MW and 1 GWh developed or acquired and more than US$1 billion invested or committed. DOE, MUFG and NY Green Bank facilities fund projects or portfolios and are not additional platform owners. No later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
